L0619

Package boundary rule `{rule}` matches no loaded import edge

What

Package boundary rule `{rule}` matches no loaded import edge

Why

Zero-match rules are dead structure policy and can hide a misspelled module name

Fix

remove the unused rule, or update it to match the intended import edge
